A wrapped U32 length is caught by rows() dying 'NO: KL-length' (policy_scales.bend:33).

name: KL-length
reason: KL.bin ends in zero bytes; H.u32s packs a cut tail to the same words, scales and configuration digest (hash_bytes.bend:42-44, policy_config.bend:28), so only this length check refuses a trimmed KL.bin. scripts/standalone-test.py now requires NO: KL-length for KL.bin missing its last byte.

name: policy-norm-F
reason: policy.txt is hashed byte-exactly into the configuration digest (policy_config.bend:27-29, join(String.lines(t),'\n')==t), so any file violating this differs from all four catalog files and is refused by Accounting.check at accounting.bend:51 'NO: unsupported-configuration' (called at policy_config.bend:69); nothing before it allocates beyond the bounded policy (65536 B) read.

name: unsupported parameter form: norm-shifts
reason: MF/KF come from policy.txt and are used before accounting only in this check. norm() at :71 allows kF>mF (e.g. MF 24, KF 30), but such a policy differs from every catalog policy and is refused by Accounting.check at accounting.bend:51 'NO: unsupported-configuration' (policy_config.bend:69), because policy.txt is hashed as join(lines,'\n') into the configuration digest (policy_config.bend:27-28).

name: request-binding-shape
reason: depth and salt are read from the plan item 'binding tree' (request_stage.bend:62-63). The plan is digest-pinned, and all four plans hold depth=6, salt=40.

name: request-binding-slot
reason: hi comes from PROOF, but a slot >= 2^48 then fails O.binding_root, which requires slot == short(depth,slot), i.e. slot < 2^6 for the pinned depth 6 (opening_bytes.bend:235,40-43). That refusal has the same name, request-binding-slot (request_stage.bend:104-106), so only the line differs.

name: request-stored-copy
reason: copy and expected are both the leaf index of the same first 12 bytes of PROOF, read once in standalone.bend:75-76 and again at request_stage.bend:185-186. They differ only if PROOF changes during the call, which the trust model excludes (verifier.md 'Don't let any input change while the call runs').

name: header-y
reason: The REPLY token comes from PROOF, but head requires it to equal the caller's y (request_walk.bend:63, NO: reply-differs). The caller's y is already checked < V at the public stage (header.bend:66, NO: token-range), so a token >= V always differs.

name: statement-range
reason: The same request words r,e were validated by Header.request_status (header.bend:64-65) at policy_statement.bend:64 and again at policy.bend:101, with t equal to the token count.

name: round-plan
reason: count, name, size and roots are fields of the digest-pinned plan Round (round_io.bend:80, plan.bend:142-149 with the Catalog.pin digest).

name: attention-forest-boundary
reason: bytes is the plan round size and n is slots(shape) from the trusted forest geometry (segment_attention.bend:42-46,70). The events list is the plan's round sequence.

name: attention-psc-values
reason: name is the plan round name, count is the number of round elements (fixed by the plan's byte size) and n is a geometry constant passed by the caller (segment_attention_psc.bend:42-47).

name: attention-psc
reason: name is the plan round name of the next algebra round, and the single-challenge pattern is fixed by the plan's draw count (segment_attention_psc.bend:79-82).

name: attention-coin
reason: name, the number of message elements (plan byte size) and the number of challenges (the plan's elements/nonzero fields via L.event, key_stage_lookup_rows.bend:41-46) are all plan-determined, and n and c are caller constants.

name: segment-mask-slot
reason: Mask slots are counters the verifier derives from the plan-sized hidden values (L.next and slot arithmetic), and slots is the segment geometry's slot count, so no PROOF byte sets a slot index.

name: segment-free-slot
reason: Whether the free slot gets a mask is fixed by the structure, and the other slots must be nonzero. The values are Fiat-Shamir challenges (or products of them and public tables), so a violation is a section 13.9 negligible event (about 2^-190 per draw); the prover cannot force it without breaking the hash.

name: segment-link-order
reason: Local.number(model) is the link counter assigned consecutively by Inputs.batches (segment_inputs.bend:59-67), and the scheduler counts from the same start, so the two always agree.

name: segment-link-order
reason: Same as site 143: Inputs.batches numbers inputs consecutively from 0 (segment_inputs.bend:63-67), and serial walks them with the same counter.

name: segment-zero-BZ-column

name: segment-digits-shape

name: segment-zero-ZZ-join

name: segment-forest-slots

name: segment-forest-planes

name: head-slot-count

name: segment-zero-U3-column

name: segment-zero-U3-column
reason: Cover.form needs a structural fit (term widths set by the verifier) and nonzero entries of challenge-derived tensors (segment_coverage.bend:72-74). name: segment-zero-U3-column
reason: Dense.fits checks the widths of read terms that the verifier itself built against row_bits(n) from the geometry, so it is structural.

name: request-terminal-dimensions

name: segment-functional-rows

name: segment-smallness-equation-count

name: segment-smallness-rng-size

name: segment-linear-count

name: segment-packing-width

name: weights-start-slot

name: weights-claim-count
reason: The only caller passes a one-element list [c] (head_weights.bend:55).

name: weights-equality-shape

name: weights-array-shape

name: file-too-long
reason: Every caller passes cap=4294967295 (key_stage.bend:164, request_stage.bend:185, leaf_stage.bend:79), and size is a U32, so U32.is_le(size,cap) always holds.

name: plan-name
reason: Names are read only from plan files (src/plan.bend:45, :86), which are opened at their catalog size and hashed. Any change to a name changes the plan digest, so src/wire_reader.bend:164 refuses with NO: plan-digest.

name: trailing-data
reason: Trailing bytes stay unread in the file, and the one-byte read at src/wire_reader.bend:148 refuses them under the same name. With :145 disabled, key.bin with 1, 7, 100 or 5000 bytes appended was still refused with NO: trailing-data.
